description: Holds Bitcoin while its 20-day average is above its 100-day average, cash otherwise. Crypto returns show strong time-series momentum. Falsified if the rule does not cut Bitcoin's drawdowns. Backtested on FinzData crypto daily closes (7-day weeks, weekends included), costs as stated, re-run free on full history.
title: Bitcoin trend · 20/100 moving average (after Liu & Tsyvinski 2021)
